newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian bond market closed on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Australian bond market closed on Monday.

text.p: The Australian bond market is closed on Monday for the Easter holidays.

The market closed little changed on Thursday after failing to sustain an early rally in the wake of offshore buying, but slightly outperformed the U.S., which remains concerned about further policy tightenings by the Federal Reserve in the coming months after this week's 25 basis point U.S. rate hike.
The benchmark November 2006 10-year bond yield ended at around 8.03 percent, down from 8.04 percent on Wednesday.
